learning_outcomes.text: Derivation of the main equation of Hydraulic Machines (Euler), inlet and outlet velocity triangles.
Learning similarity in hydraulic machines, specific speed.
Derivation of the throttling curve of a centrifugal pump.
Learning about parallel and series connection of pumps and pipe systems.
Information about hydraulic turbines and turbine selection.

syllabus_topics: Continuity Equation, Bernoulli Equation, Energy Equation, Losses
Classification of Pumps, Centrifugal-Gear-Vane and Piston Pumps, Manometric Head and Power in Pumps
Loss curves and equations, Drawing characteristic curves of pumps
Operating characteristics of pumps connected in series and parallel
Classification of Turbines, Net head and Power in Turbine
Main Dimensioning of Pelton and Banki Turbines
Main Dimensioning of Francis and Kaplan Turbines
assessment_rules: The overall grade is calculated with a 40% contribution from midterm performance (including assignments) and a 60% contribution from the final exam.
